Plugin.Name: Mains Power Monitor
Plugin.Overview: Uses a mains-powered Raspberry Pi as a proxy for mains/network availability while Unraid stays UPS-backed. After a configurable number of consecutive failed pings it records the outage and immediately triggers Unraid's native clean shutdown (powerdown), then sends one Warning-level recovery notification once connectivity returns, on the same boot or a later one. Important: this detects loss of a mains-powered network path, not mains voltage directly.
